Діагностика, що не змінює PASS/FAIL. Змі: Diagnostic only; does not change PASS/FAIL. An offset is resolved only when the full core has a unique confirmed position. A stable run contains adjacent resolved slices at the same offset; gaps and multiple possible positions break it. Transition rate = transitions / comparable pairs. A dash means unavailable data; 0 slices means no resolved positions.

Коротші затримки пришвидшують ввід. Якщо: Shorter delays make input faster. If strokes are missed, increase the delay or run Speed Probe.
Експериментальний ввід: кінці штрихів 8–: Experimental: stroke endpoints use 8–16 ms; short strokes hold for at least 40 ms. Numeric and HEX controls keep a separate minimum 16 ms interval and input verification.
Розмір, інтервал і прозорість перевіряют: Size / Interval / Opacity are verified after every change and after a pause.
Пауза застосування HEX враховує задану з: HEX application waits respect the configured delay in both input engines. The color swatch is checked every time while full clipboard readback is periodic or used after a mismatch.
Шість повільних ліній у різних місцях по: Six slow lines across Canvas: three horizontal and three vertical. Measures the dark solid core and its offset from cursor coordinates.
Після калібрування очисти полотно й запу: Clear Canvas after calibration, then run Speed Probe. Three positions per direction are a limited sample; painting still needs an audit.
Перед кожною швидкою пробою малює незале: Draws an independent nearby slow line and freezes its color before every fast trial. Compares paced movement and Shift three times, then validates a safety margin. The test can take several minutes.
Знімки, RGB і причини відмови зберігають: Snapshots, RGB and rejection reasons are saved for every stage. The test verifies the solid line core; edges and the whole image require a separate audit.
Тест залишає пробні штрихи. Після нього: The test leaves sample strokes. Clear Canvas afterwards. ESC cancels. Repeat for the Sizes you use; changed capture or shape requires a new test.
